definition: In machine learning, a Hyper basis function network, or HyperBF network, is a generalization of radial basis function (RBF) networks concept, where the Mahalanobis-like distance is used instead of the Euclidean distance measure.
details: Hyper basis function networks were first introduced by Poggio and Girosi in the 1990 paper “Networks for Approximation and Learning”.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is Hyper basis function network.
